newsitem.title: UK: Pillar sells leisure parks for 20.7 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Pillar sells leisure parks for 20.7 mln stg.

text.p: British property company Pillar Porperty Investments Plc said on Thursday it had sold two leisure parks in northern England to the MWB Leisure Fund for an aggregate net price of 20.65 million stg.
Pillar said in a statement that it had committed itself to buying the two parks from developer THI Plc last March at an aggregate price of 17.54 million stg.
It now plans to complete both the purchase and sale transactions simultaneously.

"The deal brings Pillar's total value of sales since April 1996 to over 75 million stg covering five properties and the total value of acquisitions for its investment portfolio to over 50 million stg, representing four properties," the firm said.
